style: warm domestic realism, soft practical lighting, shallow depth of field, handheld feel
negative_prompt: plastic skin, extra fingers, warped faces, watermark, subtitles, brand logos

variants.hook: My dog took the sofa. I took the 3am ceiling shift.
variants.backup_hook: Nobody warns you that a 40lb dog outranks you at bedtime.
variants.voiceover: He gets the sofa. I get the ceiling, the fridge hum, the neighbour's car door. One small lamp later and the room finally has one sound instead of nine.
variants.caption: The dog kept the sofa. I got my sleep back anyway. #sleep #whitenoise
variants.cta: Tap to see the lamp that shut the room up.
variants.music: soft lo-fi, low energy, no drop

scenes.visual: A large dog sprawled across the whole living room sofa at night, one lamp on, a person standing in the doorway holding a pillow
scenes.camera: slow push in from doorway height

scenes.visual: The same person lying awake on a floor mattress, eyes open, staring at the ceiling, faint street light moving across the wall
scenes.camera: static low angle, slight handheld drift
scenes.vo: I get the ceiling, the fridge, the neighbour's car door.

scenes.visual: Close on a small matte sleep lamp switching on beside the mattress, warm glow spreading, the room visibly settling
scenes.vo: One small lamp later, the room has one sound instead of nine.

variants.hook: My sofa filed a complaint about my sleep schedule.
variants.backup_hook: Day 400 of sleeping on furniture that clearly resents me.
variants.voiceover: Look, I am not saying the sofa was right. I am saying it stopped bringing it up after the lamp arrived.
variants.caption: Even the furniture noticed. #sleeptok #whitenoise

scenes.visual: A person collapsing onto an old sofa at 2am, laptop still open on the coffee table, half-drunk mug beside it
Same wide shot, the person sitting up, talking to the empty sofa cushion beside them with a straight face, deadpan
scenes.vo: It says I snore through the good part.

scenes.visual: Morning light, the person asleep and still, the small sleep lamp glowing faintly on the side table, the room calm
scenes.camera: slow pan from lamp to sleeping face
scenes.vo: It has not brought it up since.
